title: MagicSim: A Unified Infrastructure for Executable Embodied Interaction
abstract: arXiv:2606.17511v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Robot learning and embodied agents now require simulation to serve as a shared execution substrate linking control, skills, and planning, not only as a renderer, controller testbed, or fixed task environment. Existing pipelines split these layers with "magic" actions, disconnected training environments, or forward-only renders that cannot reproduce, evaluate, and annotate the same episode. We present MagicSim, an embodied interaction infrastructure built around one deterministic batched runtime and a shared Markov decision process (MDP). From YAML-first specifications that decouple contents, placement, behavior, and agent exposure, MagicSim constructs diverse executable worlds spanning task families, interaction regimes, physics, layouts, sensors, avatars, and robot embodiments in one reset-and-step loop. A common execution interface grounds high-level commands through controllers, atomicskills, planner primitives, and asynchro

translated_title: MagicSim：可执行具身交互的统一基础设施
translated_abstract: arXiv:2606.17511v2 公告类型：replace-cross 摘要：机器人学习与具身智能体如今要求仿真不仅充当渲染器、控制器测试平台或固定任务环境，还要成为连接控制、技能与规划的共享执行基底。现有流程通过“魔法”动作、相互割裂的训练环境或仅支持前向渲染的方式分割这些层次，无法对同一回合进行复现、评估与标注。我们提出 MagicSim，一个围绕单一确定性批量运行时与共享马尔可夫决策过程（MDP）构建的具身交互基础设施。基于将内容、摆放、行为与智能体暴露解耦的 YAML 优先规范，MagicSim 在同一个重置-步进循环中构建多样化的可执行世界，涵盖任务族、交互模式、物理特性、布局、传感器、化身与机器人本体。统一的执行接口通过控制器、原子技能、规划器原语与异步（机制）将高层指令落地执行。
tldr: MagicSim 提出了一个基于单一确定性批量运行时与共享 MDP 的具身交互仿真基础设施，通过 YAML 规范在统一的重置-步进循环中构建多样化可执行世界，打通了控制、技能与规划各层的执行接口，实现对同一回合的复现、评估与标注。
en_tdlr: MagicSim introduces a unified embodied interaction infrastructure built on a single deterministic batched runtime and shared MDP, which constructs diverse executable worlds from YAML-first specifications within one reset-and-step loop, unifying execution interfaces across control, skills, and planning for reproducible, evaluable, and annotatable episodes.
